The '''Type II blaster gas canister''' was a model of [[Blaster gas canister/Legends|blaster gas canister]] manufactured by [[Imperial Munitions/Legends|Imperial Munitions]]. The Type II was used to provide ammunition to [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]].<ref name="FOP" />
